name: tt-tnt-1024
description: TT-TNT-1024 -- a Llama-3-style model sized for Tenstorrent: num_groups=4 so it shards across 1, 2 or 4 chips, and a derived SwiGLU width of 2816 (88 tiles = 8x11) that fits a harvested Blackhole grid at 80%. Weights are the 'dialogue' run: 123M parameters, 10,764 steps on a corpus carrying a 2% instruction slice. It answers questions in form and sometimes in fact; its 4-gram repeat rate is worse than the tt-tnt-1024a control at 3.32x the seed floor.
